en.description:
Rebuild your kingdom ravaged by monsters!  Hire heroes, explore dungeons, fight monsters, rescue villagers and retrieve stolen treasure.  Soon you'll have a bustling kingdom full of houses, taverns and castles at your disposal!

FEATURES
• Use the touch screen to slash monsters and block their attacks!
• Dozens of different heroes to hire!
• Rescue hundreds of loyal subjects and their families. Each person is unique!
• Explore over 20 different dungeons full of monsters and treasure!
• Master a variety of magic spells!
• Customize your kingdom with different types of buildings, castles and decorations!
• Produce food to level up your heroes and make them stronger!
• Earn money from your loyal subjects to buy more buildings and pay heroes!
• Find and equip rare magic rings!
• Use the Kingdom Economy Report to see how your kingdom is improving day by day!
• Take a photo of your kingdom to share with friends!
• Supports Game Center with high scores and achievements!

By installing this application you agree to the terms of the licensed agreements.
en.releaseNotes:
This update from Apple will improve the functionality of this app. No new features are included.

NEW NAME AND ICON!
Your eyes do not deceive you. This update gives the game a brand new name and icon. The old name didn't really explain what the game was about, ie. hire heroes and raid dungeons. I think the new name makes that very clear!

NEW STUFF!
• Updated for iOS 10!
• The ask to rate pop up now stops showing after you've said no thanks!
• The economy report now shows the number of Food and Coin buildings in your kingdom!
• The pop up advert when the game loads has been removed (yay!)

PREVIOUS RELEASE (in case you missed it)
• The new Kingdom Economy Report shows how your kingdom is doing with growth stats and daily earning potential
• Loyal subjects now have hobbies, likes, moods and family relationships
• The new Kingdom Roll shows all loyal subject stats including age and happiness
• The new Happiness rating lets you earn bonus Gems each day for making your loyal subjects happy
• There are brand new loyal subjects to rescue
• The Treasury is now an IAP that doubles Coins and Food and produces a Gem every minute
• New startup tips give you valuable playing advice

ENHANCEMENTS!
• You can now house more loyal subjects so your kingdom can earn more money!
• Shake to collect ALL Coins, Food and Gems with totals collected shown on screen!
• Watching a video now does a FULL revive on heroes!
• You are told when your buildings have finished construction!
• New Rate button makes it easier to let me know what you think of the game!

Thanks for playing!
- Johnno, your the dungeon master

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
- New goal system to keep you questing for rewards!
- Upgrade your heroes’ style from grand to legendary!
- Deeper combat mechanics to keep you on your toes!
Heroes can now find powerful loot to equip!

TAKE A PHOTO
Touch the new Camera icon to share a photo of your village by email, Facebook or Twitter

TURN OFF ADS
Purchase any Coin, Food or Gem pack to turn off ads

GENERAL FIXES
Minor user interface tweaks

MORE HEALTH FOR TIRED HEROES - recovering the health of a tired hero now restores more health points!

SAVE LOOT BY WATCHING VIDEOS - you can now save magic rings by watching a video instead of spending precious gems!

BIGGER TEXT - larger text for shop prices makes for easier reading!

TURN OFF ADS - buy any Gem, Coin or Food pack to turn off ads!

BUG FIXES - the far right of the shop scroll screen now responds to touch on iPhone 5.

Thanks for all the kind words and support, we’ve already started working on the next update!

* Brand new Daily Bonus screen!
* Improved combat - enemies don't automatically attack!
* Completing Goals gives bigger Gem rewards!
* Recovering the health of a tired hero now restores more health points!
* Save magic rings by watching a video instead of spending precious gems!
* Larger text for shop prices makes for easier reading!
* Buy any Gem, Coin or Food pack to turn off ads!
Thanks for all the kind words and support!

** iOS 8 compatibility release **
Hooray! Save Our Village is now iOS 8 compatible and should look gorgeous on an iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus.

We've also overhauled the game engine, not that you should notice, but it means we can now get updates out on a more timely fashion!

Thanks for playing. And let us know what you'd like to see next on our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/saveourvillage

Hello brave adventurers, I’ve added some cool stuff in this update!

- The game now runs at 60 frames per second. So it should feel silky smooth!
- Trapped heroes are visible on the dungeon map so they are easier to find and rescue!
- Achievements and Leaderboards are just a tap away on the village screen!
- Updated the Achievement images so they are all interesting and not just boring chests anymore!
- Credit screen scrolling is silky smooth. Not a big change, but it bugged me being so slow.
- Now with 64 bit support!

Thanks for playing!
- Johnno, your dungeon master

BRAND NEW STUFF!
• The new Villager Economy Report shows how your village is doing with growth stats and daily earning potential
• Villagers now have hobbies, likes, moods and family relationships
• The new Villager Roll shows all villager stats including age and happiness
• The new Villager Happiness rating lets you earn bonus Gems each day for making villagers happy
• There are brand new villagers to rescue
• The Treasury is now an IAP that doubles Coins and Food and produces a Gem every minute
• New startup tips give you valuable playing advice

ENHANCEMENTS!
• You can now house more villagers so your village is a lot more active!
• Shake to collect ALL Coins, Food and Gems with totals collected shown on screen!
• Watching a video now does a FULL revive on heroes!
• You are told when your buildings have finished construction!
• New Rate button makes it easier to let me know what you think of the game!
• The pop up ad on game load has been removed (yay!)
• Lots of UI tweaks and improvements

Thanks for playing!
- Johnno, your Dungeon Master

Introducing Lord Zac and Lady Ella, special villagers that help you in your quest.  Both can be found roaming the village.

• Lord Zac will trade Food for Gems so you can level up your heroes faster!
• Lady Ella let's you name your village and send postcards!

Also included in this update are brand new share screens for each hero.

Thanks for playing!
- Johnno, your Dungeon Master
